translations.<accent>Averse (Blade Storm)</accent> es: <accent>Blade Storm</accent> is Jett's Ultimate. Activate the ability to equip a set of <accent>5 deadly knives</accent> that are highly accurate. Each knife deals <accent>50 body damage</accent> and <accent>150 head damage</accent> (instant kill). The weapon is perfectly accurate even while moving and jumping, making it the ideal tool combined with Jett's Dash and Drift to become a nearly impossible target to hit. Each kill <accent>recharges all knives</accent> back to 5, making this Ultimate potentially endless during a multi-kill. Cost: <accent>7 Ultimate points</accent>.
translations.<accent>Courant ascendant (Updraft)</acc: <accent>Updraft</accent> is Jett's vertical mobility ability. Activate the ability to instantly propel yourself into the air. This vertical boost allows you to reach high positions inaccessible to other agents, such as on top of boxes, containers, or structures. Combined with Jett's passive <accent>Drift</accent> ability (holding the jump key in the air), this ability becomes a formidable tool to take unexpected angles and surprise the opponent from above. Cost: <accent>150 credits</accent> - 1 max charge.
translations.<accent>Éclats de nuage (Cloudburst)</ac: <accent>Cloudburst</accent> is Jett's vision-blocking ability. Instantly throw a projectile that expands into a vision-blocking cloud of smoke upon impacting a surface. It is a highly reactive tool, ideal for creating emergency cover, blocking an enemy sniper's (Operator) line of sight, or facilitating a entry (dash) onto site. The smoke dissipates very quickly (<accent>2.5 seconds</accent>), requiring perfect timing to gain maximum advantage.
translations.<accent>Vent arrière (Tailwind)</accent>: <accent>Tailwind</accent> is Jett's signature mobility ability, feared for its unpredictability. Press the ability key once to <accent>prepare</accent> it. After a brief moment, a <accent>12-second</accent> window activates. During this window, you can reactivate the ability to perform an extremely fast dash. It is the perfect tool to take aggressive fights (especially with a sniper) and escape instantly before the enemy can trade back, or to break defensive lines when entering a site. The ability recharges after getting <accent>2 kills</accent>.

translations.Activez <accent>Courant ascendant</accen: Activate <accent>Updraft</accent> to instantly launch yourself upward. Combine with <accent>Tailwind (Dash)</accent> in the air for unpredictable aerial movements.

translations.Avec le <accent>clic droit</accent>, Jet: With <accent>Right Click</accent>, Jett throws all <accent>5 knives simultaneously</accent> in a spread. This firing mode is devastating at <accent>close range</accent>: if multiple knives hit the target, the damage stacks for an almost guaranteed kill. Perfect for rushes or after an aggressive Dash onto an isolated enemy. Be careful, all knives are consumed at once, even on a kill.
translations.Avec le <accent>clic gauche</accent>, Je: With <accent>Left Click</accent>, Jett throws knives <accent>one by one</accent> with surgical precision. Each knife is perfectly accurate, even in mid-air or while moving. This mode is ideal for medium to long-range duels where every shot counts. Aim for the head for an <accent>instant kill</accent> (150 damage). Remaining knives are restored after each kill.
